## `ew project assets purge`

```text
ew project assets purge [--project <project>] [--preview]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--preview` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | confirmed, done and saved |
| 1 | refused or not confirmed |
| 2 | usage, no controlling terminal, open and save errors |

**Result:** none; the subcommand prints text only.
